name: ab_preserved_mul
statement: (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (A : Set ℝ) (hA : ∀ x ∈ A, ∀ y ∈ A, x * y ∈ A) (hf : f '' A ⊆ A) (hg : g '' A ⊆ A) : (fun x => f x * g x) '' A ⊆ A
closed: ∀ (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (A : Set ℝ) (hA : ∀ x ∈ A, ∀ y ∈ A, x * y ∈ A) (hf : f '' A ⊆ A) (hg : g '' A ⊆ A), (fun x => f x * g x) '' A ⊆ A
informal: If A is closed under multiplication and f, g are preserved in A then f × g is preserved in A.
original: Let f,g : R → R be functions and a ⊂ R. Suppose x × y ∈ A for all x,y ∈ A. Prove that if f and g are preserved in A then f × g is preserved in A. (Here f × g = f(x) × g(x).)
type: ∀ (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (A : Set ℝ), (∀ x ∈ A, ∀ y ∈ A, x * y ∈ A) → f '' A ⊆ A → g '' A ⊆ A → (fun x => f x * g x) '' A ⊆ A
